note: Action histories + sponsors for 2022-2024 bills, from Internet Archive snapshots of openstates.org bill pages (OpenStates mirrors the official GenCourt docket). Actions are listed newest first, as rendered. Each record carries its snapshot URL. Used to stage deaths that roll calls alone cannot resolve; vote counts still come only from GenCourt SQL. 2023-2024 bills (and 2022 leftovers) come from archived LegiScan bill pages (source=legiscan_wayback), which mirror the GenCourt docket with journal citations. Bills unresolvable from snapshots (2022 SB415, 2023 SB203) and post-passage fates (2023 SB145, 2024 HB1291) were resolved by web research from official/news sources; each carries citations and is used only for disposition staging, never for vote counts.

bills.title: relative to the composition and jurisdiction of the manufactured housing board.
bills.resolution: Passed the Senate (Ought to Pass w/Amendment, voice vote, 2023-03-16; the 12-12 tabling roll call that day failed). The House passed it with a new-title amendment 19-0 committee / voice floor on 2023-05-04; the Senate nonconcurred and requested a committee of conference; the House refused to accede (GenCourt status: REFUSED TO ACCEDE TO REQUEST) — the bill died between the chambers. Separately, HB2 2023 (Chapter 79:301) repealed the Board of Manufactured Housing statutes RSA 205-A:25-31 effective 2023-09-01.
